job.title: [Post] Hari Haran Marepalli
job.email_subject: Application: Automation Testing role – Kranti Chavan
job.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I saw your automation testing post – I bring 5+ years of Java engineering with a strong quality focus, including JUnit test suites and UAT on enterprise e-commerce platforms. What I bring in concrete terms:

– Automated unit and integration tests with JUnit
– REST / SOAP API know-how and production troubleshooting
– CI/CD deployment cycles and AI-assisted testing

This lets me take on real responsibility in your team from day one. I live in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit and can start on 16 December 2026. My CV and cover letter are attached, and I am happy to walk you through my projects in detail. Could we set up a short 15-minute call in the next few days? I look forward to hearing from you.

Kind regards
Kranti Chavan

tailoring.headline: Java Developer – Test Automation & Quality | JUnit, REST APIs & CI/CD
tailoring.summary: Java developer with 5+ years on enterprise e-commerce platforms (SAP Commerce Cloud / Hybris) for Rockwell Automation, Shell and Cognizant, with a strong quality focus. Built automated unit and integration test suites with JUnit to maintain code quality and coverage, supported UAT with business teams and executed CI/CD deployment cycles in agile DevOps workflows. Strong in Java, Spring Boot, REST and SOAP web services, SQL and production troubleshooting, and uses AI tools extensively to accelerate development and testing.
tailoring.why_company: Your post is about quality and automation, which has run through my whole career, from JUnit suites at Cognizant to UAT and production support at Shell and Rockwell Automation. I want to bring that Java and API depth to a team that treats testing as an engineering discipline. My combination of hands-on platform depth and close work with business teams is exactly what I want to put to work for you.
